questions: What happens when nothing survives normalization?
assumptions: The helper stays pure: no I/O, no dependencies

approaches.summary: NFKD normalize, strip combining marks, map non-alphanumeric runs to dashes, trim, cap length, fall back.
tradeoffs: ASCII slugs only — non-Latin headings fall back to 'untitled'

approaches.summary: Depend on a full transliteration package for broader script coverage.
tradeoffs: Adds a dependency and a supply-chain surface for a cosmetic fallback gain

recommendation.rationale: The fallback behavior is already pinned by tests; a dependency buys nothing this toy needs.

design.architecture: One pure function `slugify(value, { maxLength })` in `src/slug.js`; behavior pinned by `test/slug.test.mjs`.
dataFlow: input string -> NFKD + lower -> dash mapping -> trim/cap -> slug or 'untitled'
errorHandling: Empty result resolves to the 'untitled' fallback
testing: Test file written before the implementation (RED observed)
Unicode, punctuation, empty, and truncation cases pinned
